verdict: Noncryptographic production expansion has been removed. Circular security is accepted for the current RAM evaluation-key graph. The remaining lvl1 sigma128 family misses the strict128-bit classical screen under MATZOV; its dedicated assessment recommends sigma256 and full affected-material regeneration. Complete security is not inferred from cost estimates.

algebra.map: F(X)=sum_(r=0)^15 X^r F_r(X^16), R_N(q) direct-sum X^r R_n(q) as an R_n module
algebra.error_distribution: Coefficient deinterleaving is a permutation: independent per-coefficient ideal noise remains independent with sigma256. There is no factor16 trace average or reduction to n=64.
algebra.conditional_reduction: For independently sampled s and t, after giving s to a distinguisher and subtracting each known g_j*s_r, the one-way bridge is precisely 256 polynomial samples of small-ring RLWE. This assumes uniform/pseudorandom masks and the actual small-ring error law. It does not simulate t-dependent auxiliary keys or prove cyclic composition.
algebra.further_subring: Splitting a dense target t again generally increases module rank; it does not preserve a rank-one smaller secret with a smaller total unknown dimension.
algebra.modulus_caveat: The coefficient-module identity holds for q=2^32. The cited preliminary BGV lemma uses odd q and a factor2 in its encryption, so its exact theorem is not asserted verbatim for this torus instantiation.

mask_finding.location: include/ckks/subring_switch.hpp:49 -> scheme_switching.hpp exactEncryptPolynomialAtLevel -> ckks.hpp fillSeededUniformPolynomialAtLevel -> CKKSSeedStream
mask_finding.fold: state starts at constant; for each of four words state=mix(state XOR word). All expansion depends only on final 64-bit state.
mask_finding.constant_time_seed_collision: Choose any first three alternate words. Let u be their folded state and z be the desired final state. Set the fourth word to u XOR unmix(z). The final states and all stream outputs are equal.
mask_finding.full_q32_mask_distinguisher: Enumerate the 2^32 possible upper halves of the first 32-bit output, invert the bijective 64-bit mixer, then test subsequent outputs at the known Weyl step. Four q32 outputs admit at most probability 2^-64 of a uniform-mask match by a union bound. This costs about 2^32 candidate states, not 2^128.
mask_finding.demonstration_scope: The Python run enumerated a deliberately restricted 2^12 suffix range. It did not execute a full 2^32 search. A C++ probe verified two colliding seeds give 16384 identical 64-bit outputs in the actual class.
mask_finding.not_demonstrated: Neither seed collision nor public-mask state recovery alone recovers t or plaintext: masks are already public. No 2^32 secret-recovery bound or 64-bit encryption-security cap is claimed.
mask_finding.backend: USE_BLAKE3 seeds the top-level RNG and hashes archive origins, but CKKSSeedStream still runs SplitMix. Full expansion into a raw key does not change that mask law.
mask_finding.archive: The v1 archive profile does not bind a cryptographic mask-generator identifier. Increasing Gaussian noise or rehashing the file does not fix mask generation.
mask_finding.other_families: The inspected RAM packing, direct bridges, retained native automorphism setup, direct selector setup and compact DD setup use full-mask TRLWE/TLWE encryption paths. They are not marked affected by this specific seeded-mask finding. Other uses of CKKSSeeded* remain subject to the same review.

conditional_lattice_screens.scope: Classical generic LWE proxies, conditional on uniform masks. Does not qualify existing SplitMix masks, ring-specific attacks, or cyclic key composition.

sampler.implementation: std::normal_distribution<long double> followed by truncation toward zero through signedLongDoubleToLevel
sampler.variance_proxy_limit: Variance matching does not make the PMFs identical or negligibly close. The measured numerical single-coefficient TV distance is recorded below; no negligible joint-distribution replacement is established.
sampler.finite_precision_limit: No constant-time, finite-precision statistical-distance or 2^-128 exact-sampler proof was established. Side channels are outside these numerical estimates.

composition.conclusion: The t -> u -> s -> t cycle already exists with direct output switching. Ordinary independent-key IND-CPA alone does not supply a hybrid proof for the entire public graph. The ring variant needs a compatible circular/KDM assumption or an explicit composition proof.
composition.acyclic_option: Finite-depth key layers can use distinct source/destination secrets per epoch and one-way switches to avoid inter-epoch cycles, with new material and costs. Repeated fixed-key RAM and self-key relinearization are not unconditionally covered by that suggestion.

whole_system_limits.legacy_sigma128: The seven-attack generic proxy minimum remains 127.7888055343365 MATZOV bits. The direct legacy key, ordinary lvl1 encryptions and TFHE eval families must be assessed together; changing only the new ring-key sigma does not qualify those exposures.
whole_system_limits.history: If weak material was previously disclosed for reused secrets, regenerating stronger evaluation keys does not revoke it. A private old checkpoint by itself is not evidence of disclosure.
whole_system_limits.correctness: The audited fixed ring key has deterministic added-error bound 0.024777563754469156 for arbitrary full radix4 digit choices. This does not depend on an ideal-normal tail assumption. Adding the assumed/audited input budget1/16 gives0.08727756375446916<1/8. Universal upstream noise for unbounded RAM execution remains unproved.
whole_system_limits.quantum: Only classical BDGL16 and MATZOV screens were run; no 128-bit quantum-security claim is made.

algebra.mask_attack_scope: Distinguishes mask expansion from uniform; does not recover an encryption secret or plaintext.
algebra.noise_scope: Ideal continuous-normal truncation PMF, numerical quadrature on +/-12 sigma; not a finite-precision sampler proof.

remediation_order: Replace new bridge seeded-mask generation with full masks from the existing CSPRNG and explicit exact encryption, or use a separately specified cryptographic expander. Version the mask law and refuse v1 as a qualified format.
Generate replacement evaluation material without overwriting historical comparison fixtures; independently audit noise, mask provenance, correctness and performance.
Retune and inventory all public exposures under each shared secret, including ordinary TFHE encryptions and evaluation material; rotate affected secrets if old material was disclosed.
State and analyze the full circular/KDM assumption; use finite key layers where an acyclic deployment is required.
Reassess the actual error sampler, structural/quantum attacks and bounded operational failure probability before claiming production security.

historical_v1_verdict: The subring construction has an exact small-ring RLWE interpretation, but the implemented v1 key generator uses a noncryptographic 64-bit-state mask expander. Uniform-mask lattice screens do not qualify the generated v1 ring keys. Existing sigma128 TFHE exposures and cyclic evaluation-key assumptions independently prevent a full 128-bit qualification.
